## David Ruggiero, briefing for the Microsoft-hosted Dallas golf event

**Confidence note:** there are several people with this name (see disambiguation below). Everything below is attributed to the DFW tech-executive David Ruggiero. His current employer has one soft spot, flagged explicitly.

### Who he is
An enterprise sales executive, based in **Dallas–Fort Worth, Texas**, with **25+ years** leading sales organizations across enterprise software, telecom, and life sciences. Career profile fits "Microsoft or Microsoft-connected tech exec in DFW" exactly.

### Current role / company
- His LinkedIn (linkedin.com/in/davidruggiero) currently shows his company as **Microsoft** (profile topcard and page title both resolve to Microsoft), location **Dallas–Fort Worth Metroplex**, headline: *"Microsoft Sales Leader, Co-Founder Iron Mend LLC | Board Member of Peak Tech AI."*
- Caveat: his **most recent public appointment** was **Global Head of Sales & Service at PacBio (NASDAQ: PACB)**, announced Feb 3, 2025 (started Feb 10, 2025). LinkedIn now pointing at Microsoft suggests he has since **rejoined Microsoft**, but his exact Microsoft title is not publicly visible (guest view hides it). His earlier Microsoft title was **VP, Digital Sales, North America** (multi-cloud growth). Do not state a specific current title with certainty.

### Career background (well documented)
- **Early:** Qwest, Avaya, then **Cisco**, where he was **Area VP, Cisco Commercial South Area**, credited in a LinkedIn recommendation with taking the region "from worst to first" in under a year.
- **Microsoft:** VP, Digital Sales North America; a former colleague also credits him with a **GM role for the US and Canada business**.
- **Zoom:** senior sales leadership, Head of Sales North America.
- **Thermo Fisher Scientific / Life Technologies:** Chief Commercial Officer, Life Sciences Solutions Group.
- **Outreach:** **President of Go-To-Market** (May 2023), running global sales, marketing, and customer success; reported to CEO Manny Medina.
- **Sinch AB:** **SVP, North America** (Nov 2024), explicitly based in Dallas.
- **PacBio:** Global Head of Sales & Service (Feb 2025).
- Education: an undergraduate program **1984–1988** appears on his profile but the school/degree is masked to non-connections. (That date range implies he is in his late 50s.)

### Side ventures (good small-talk material)
- **Co-Founder, IronMend LLC** (ironmendllc.com), a telehealth business selling compounded peptide therapy and TRT via licensed US pharmacies. The site's founder is **Daniel Ruggiero** (likely a relative), so David appears to be the co-founder/business-side partner, not the front person.
- **Board member, Peak Tech AI** (peak-tech.ai), an AI startup-ecosystem builder focused on **Africa**; registered in Singapore (Peak Tech AI Pte Ltd) with a South Africa arm (peaktech.co.za).
- Around 2024 he publicly announced starting **GTM coaching, fractional CRO work, and leadership training** (this is the Iron Mend practice).

### Public footprint
Sinch and PacBio press releases (Nov 2024, Feb 2025) carried by Nasdaq, Yahoo Finance, BioSpace, TipRanks, StockTitan, Contract Pharma; Demand Gen Report covered the 2023 Outreach appointment. 5.1K LinkedIn followers, 9 recommendations.

### Talking points
1. **Sales turnaround war stories:** the Cisco Commercial South Area "worst to first" arc is a safe, flattering opener he clearly prizes.
2. **Microsoft boomerang:** genuinely ask how the Microsoft of today compares to his VP Digital Sales years. He has vendor-side perspective on the multi-cloud era.
3. **DFW to Africa:** Peak Tech AI, an Africa-focused AI ecosystem builder, is unusual and likely something he enjoys talking about.
4. **Health/performance:** IronMend (peptides, TRT, recovery, telehealth) is a live interest. Note: the jiu-jitsu injury story on the site belongs to founder Daniel Ruggiero, so do not attribute the martial-arts injury to David.
5. **Avoid:** the tattoo artist and any assumption he is "just" a Microsoft lifer. He has moved between Microsoft, Zoom, Cisco, Outreach, Sinch, and PacBio, so frame him as a multi-company operator.

### Disambiguation (other David Ruggieros found)
- Tattoo artist from Ink Master (excluded, confirmed separate).
- David Ruggiero, VP, Hamric Capital, New York City.
- "@thedavidmentor" on Instagram, a coaching/content creator.
- Jonathan David Ruggiero, Workday patent inventor.
- Daniel Ruggiero, IronMend founder (also an Intuit mid-market AE), likely a relative of the subject.

### Not found
No public golf-specific information (handicap, club, course affiliation, or past tournament mentions) for this David Ruggiero. Nothing personal beyond the ventures above.
